title: Characteristic Polynomials of Graph- and Digraph-Deleted Catalan Arrangements
summary: We develop a finite-field stratification for characteristic polynomials of deletion subarrangements of the full $m$-Catalan arrangement. It reduces the count to cyclic placements of rigid blocks and yields falling-factorial expansions for deletions indexed by graphs, digraphs, and gain-labeled digraphs. The coefficients are graphical Stirling numbers for zero-layer deletions, directed matching numbers when the deleted layer $\ell$ satisfies $1\le \ell\le\lfloor m/2\rfloor$, directed path-cover numbers when $\lfloor m/2\rfloor<\ell\le m$, and admissible gain-labeled arc sets for multilayer…
